tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description: Get annual or quarterly financial-statement time series for a stock or ETF. Modules can return all statements or a smaller financials, balance-sheet, or cash-flow payload.

tools.name: get_macro_snapshot
tools.description: Get the current mkts macro dashboard, including major equity proxies, crypto, commodities, the US dollar, volatility, and the US 10-year yield.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Get the current global cryptocurrency market totals, volume, dominance, active asset counts, and the underlying snapshot timestamp.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Get recent market news from the configured source feeds. Filter by an asset symbol or by markets, crypto, commodities, or forex category. Returns source and publication links.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get bounded daily price history for a symbol. Stocks and ETFs include OHLCV when available; cryptocurrency history may contain close and volume only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_asset_profile, get_news · Private data: compare_assets, get_filings · Public sink: get_asset_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_asset_profile, get_news · Private data: compare_assets, get_filings · Public sink: get_asset_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
